command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
LOOPDEV=/dev/loop9
echo "== STEP: attach loop device =="
sudo -n losetup "$LOOPDEV" /var/lib/srv-data/backing.img
sudo -n losetup -a

sudo -n vgcreate vg_data "$LOOPDEV"
sudo -n lvcreate -L 1G -n lv_data vg_data
sudo -n lvs vg_data

echo "== STEP: mkfs.xfs =="
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f /dev/vg_data/lv_data

echo "== STEP: mount =="

sudo -n mount /dev/vg_data/lv_data /srv/data
df -hT /srv/data

echo "== STEP: systemd unit for loop attach at boot =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop device backing vg_data for /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udevd.service local-fs-pre.target
Before=local-fs-pre.target
Conflicts=umount.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup /dev/loop9 /var/lib/srv-data/backing.img
ExecStart=/sbin/vgchange -ay vg_data
ExecStop=/sbin/vgchange -an vg_data
ExecStop=/sbin/losetup -d /dev/loop9

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
EOF
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable srv-data-loop.service
